name: Azuresteel Cut
description: Cut with the first plain stroke of the school and let a pale blue edge of qi follow the steel.

name: Azuresteel Guard
description: Hold the blade in the school's first guard so a thin blue shell of qi takes the blow.

name: Azuresteel Pace
description: Take the school's first measured step with the blade level so the point never leaves its line.

name: Azuresteel Surge
description: Surge on a blue line of qi and cut as the feet land so body and edge arrive together.

name: Azuresteel Parry
description: Turn a blow aside on the blue edge and send the answering cut along the line it opened.

name: Azuresteel Sense
description: Let blue qi run along the blade to read the reach and grip of a stranger's weapon.

name: Azuresteel Rend
description: Cut with the dense blue edge in one stroke that rends guard and armor alike.

name: Azuresteel Aegis
description: Hold a broad layered shell of blue qi about the wielder against a sustained assault.

name: Azuresteel Zenith
description: Gather the school's qi at the top of a rising guard and cut so the stroke breaks the target's stance.

name: Azure Sword Dawn
description: The school's closing form: raise the blade through a long breath then cut once in a pale arc whose force grows with skill.

name: Twinhawk Cut
description: Cut in the course's first stoop with the blade falling from the shoulder in a short arc.

name: Twinhawk Wing
description: Spread the blade and the off arm like a pair of wings to take a blow on a wide guard of qi.

name: Twinhawk Pace
description: Skim forward in a low hawk crouch to close the distance beneath the target's guard.

name: Twinhawk Stoop
description: Drop from a leap in a steep stoop and cut the target's shoulder as the body lands beyond.

name: Twinhawk Parry
description: Beat a blow off line with the flat and cut back from the second hawk's angle.

name: Twinhawk Talon
description: Rake the point down the target's weapon arm in two talons of qi that spoil the grip.

name: Twinhawk Eye
description: Lift the blade and sharpen the wielder's sight with qi until each weak point in the target's stance shows.

name: Twinhawk Rend
description: Fall on the target from above with two cuts that land as one and rend the guard.

name: Twinhawk Pinion
description: Spread paired pinions of qi on either side of the wielder to catch blows from both flanks.

name: Twinhawk Descent
description: Flash down from above on a pinion of qi and pierce through the target in a single stoop.

name: Hawkfall Edge
description: The course's closing form: the blade falls like a hawk in one stroke whose weight rises with the wielder's skill.

name: Pairblade Cut
description: Cut with one blade of qi and hold the second ready beside it for the next stroke.

name: Pairblade Ward
description: Cross the two blades before the chest so a blow breaks upon the crossing.

name: Pairblade Thrust
description: Thrust with both blades along parallel lines so the target cannot turn both aside.

name: Pairblade Pace
description: Glide forward with a blade on each side so the pair leads the body in.

name: Pairblade Cross
description: Cut in a scissor of two arcs that cross at the target and cut off its retreat.

name: Pairblade Parry
description: Catch a thrust between the two blades and turn it past the body in one twist.

name: Pairblade Bind
description: Close both blades on the target's weapon like tongs and hold it still.

name: Pairblade Surge
description: Surge in behind both blades so two cuts land as the feet land.

name: Pairblade Rend
description: Bring both blades down together in one crushing rend that tears through the guard.

name: Pairblade Aegis
description: Hold the crossed blades as a living guard that shields the wielder and cuts what presses it.

name: Pairblade Apex
description: Gather both blades into a great crossing sweep that cuts every foe within reach.

name: Twinfall Edge
description: The course's closing form: both blades fall as one in twin strokes whose force rises with the wielder's skill.

name: Dualtrack Cut
description: Cut down the first track of qi with the second track running a hand's breadth beside it.

name: Dualtrack Ward
description: Raise two tracks of qi along the blade so a blow that slips one meets the other.

name: Dualtrack Pace
description: Step along one track with the second held ready for a change of line.

name: Dualtrack Surge
description: Run the body down one track and the blade down the other so the cut lands as the feet land.

name: Dualtrack Parry
description: Turn a blow on one track of qi and let the other spring back as a cut.

name: Dualtrack Sense
description: Run twin threads of qi along a stranger's blade to compare reach and grip.

name: Dualtrack Rend
description: Bring both tracks down together to rend the guard along two lines at once.

name: Dualtrack Aegis
description: Hold two layered tracks of qi before the body so each blow must break one and then the other.

name: Dualtrack Apex
description: Gather both tracks and cut so one binds the target's blade while the other lands.

name: Dual Sunder
description: The school's closing form: both tracks close on the target together and bind the blade in one stroke whose force grows with skill.

name: Crownsteel Cut
description: Cut with the calm authority of the canon so the stroke lands as though ordered.

name: Crownsteel Ward
description: Hold the blade in a still guard so a broad shell of qi takes the blow.

name: Crownsteel Thrust
description: Thrust the point straight at the mark with all of the wielder's authority behind it.

name: Crownsteel Pace
description: Advance with an even unhurried pace so the blade is always ready at the end of it.

name: Crownsteel Surge
description: Surge to the target in one long stride and cut before the pace has finished.

name: Crownsteel Parry
description: Turn a blow with the flat and return a cut that carries the full weight of the canon.

name: Crownsteel Bind
description: Lay a firm thread of qi over the target's weapon and hold it down.

name: Crownsteel Sense
description: Open the blade to the field about the wielder and read every weapon within it.

name: Crownsteel Rend
description: Cut with the canon's authority so the edge rends whatever it is ordered through.

name: Crownsteel Aegis
description: Raise a layered dome of qi over the wielder and allies that holds against heavy assault.

name: Crownsteel Dominion
description: Cut a great arc that strikes every foe in reach and bows the qi of those it touches.

name: Sword Sovereign's Verdict
description: The canon's closing form: the wielder passes judgment in one stroke whose force and weight rise with the wielder's skill.

name: Swornblade Cut
description: Cut along the sworn line without bend so the edge keeps the school's first oath.

name: Swornblade Ward
description: Hold the blade to the sworn line so qi stiffens in the steel and takes the blow.

name: Swornblade Pace
description: Advance a firm pace on the sworn line with the point on the same bearing.

name: Swornblade Edge
description: Cut with an edge hardened by the oath so no feint can turn the stroke aside.

name: Swornblade Parry
description: Turn the blow on the sworn line and cut back along it at once.

name: Swornblade Hold
description: Hold the target's blade to the sworn line with a thread of qi until the striker tires.

name: Swornblade Mark
description: Mark the line of the target's stance with a thread of qi and feel where it will not bend.

name: Swornblade Rend
description: Cut with the whole weight of the oath so the edge rends everything standing on the line.

name: Swornblade Aegis
description: Stand firm on the sworn line so its qi shields the wielder and steadies allies beside.

name: Swornblade Apex
description: Cut with the oath fully drawn so the stroke lands and seals the target's qi along the wound.

name: Oathfall Edge
description: The school's closing form: the whole oath falls on the edge in one stroke whose weight rises with the wielder's skill.

name: Headingblade Cut
description: Cut along the taken heading with the blade true to the line from start to finish.

name: Headingblade Ward
description: Hold the blade on its heading so a flat shell of qi stands where the blow must fall.

name: Headingblade Pace
description: Hold the heading while taking a pace round the target so the point never leaves its line.

name: Headingblade Edge
description: Cut on the heading with an edge no feint can turn from its line.

name: Headingblade Parry
description: Turn the blow along the heading and cut back on the same line.

name: Headingblade Sense
description: Send a thread of qi along the heading to feel where the target stands and moves.

name: Headingblade Rend
description: Rend along the held heading with an edge that nothing in the line can stop.

name: Headingblade Aegis
description: Hold the heading against a rising run of blows with a rooted aegis of qi.

name: Headingblade Apex
description: Flash along the held heading in one stroke and arrive with the cut already landed.

name: Truecourse Edge
description: The course's closing form: a single cut that never leaves the true heading and grows in force with the wielder's skill.

name: Freeblade Cut
description: Cut from no set stance so the blade leaves the guard on a line the target did not read.

name: Freeblade Ward
description: Let a shell of qi form only where the blow falls and leave the body free elsewhere.

name: Freeblade Thrust
description: Thrust from a slack hand so the point arrives from where the target was not looking.

name: Freeblade Drift
description: Drift on a loose line past the guard with the blade trailing at ease.

name: Freeblade Edge
description: Cut with the edge free of any set path so each stroke picks its line in the moment.

name: Freeblade Parry
description: Slip a blow by going loose and turning its force off with the blade.

name: Freeblade Break
description: Break the rhythm of a fixed stance by cutting wherever the guard is not.

name: Freeblade Sense
description: Leave the blade bare to the air and feel through it every shift in the target's weight.

name: Freeblade Rend
description: Cut free of every guard with the open edge's full force to rend the defense.

name: Freeblade Shell
description: Move without a fixed line while a loose shell of qi follows the body and meets each blow.

name: Freeblade Apex
description: Pass the blade through the target's guard as if it were not there and cut as it forms again.

name: Boundless Edge
description: The course's closing form: the edge cuts from any line without bound and its force rises with the wielder's skill.

name: Oathlong Cut
description: Cut with the same measured stroke as the first of the fight however long it has run.

name: Oathlong Ward
description: Hold the guard to the oath through a long exchange so qi never thins along the blade.

name: Oathlong Pace
description: Take a long even pace that keeps the oath and the blade in line.

name: Oathlong Edge
description: Cut with an edge that has not tired since the oath was sworn.

name: Oathlong Parry
description: Turn the blow and cut back on the oath line while the striker's weight is still forward.

name: Oathlong Hold
description: Hold the target's blade to the oath line with a steady thread of qi until the striker tires.

name: Oathlong Mark
description: Hold the oath and sense along the blade where the target's strength is draining.

name: Oathlong Rend
description: Rend through the target with the strength the oath has stored across the long fight.

name: Oathlong Aegis
description: Spread the oath over the wielder and allies as a shell that also steadies their cuts.

name: Oathlong Apex
description: Cut with the long oath behind the edge so the stroke lands and presses down the target's qi.

name: Oathbound Steel
description: The school's closing form: the wielder holds one oath unbroken and cuts and guards with force that rises with skill.

name: Kingbearing Cut
description: Cut along the sovereign bearing with the weight of long command behind the edge.

name: Kingbearing Ward
description: Hold the blade on the sovereign bearing so a still shell of qi takes the blow.

name: Kingbearing Pace
description: Advance on the sovereign bearing at an unhurried pace with the point always leading.

name: Kingbearing Edge
description: Cut with an edge that no feint can draw from the bearing it holds.

name: Kingbearing Parry
description: Turn a blow along the bearing and answer on the same line.

name: Kingbearing Sense
description: Send qi out along the bearing to learn the reach and weight of every weapon in range.

name: Kingbearing Rend
description: Rend along the sovereign bearing with an edge no guard in its line can bar.

name: Kingbearing Aegis
description: Hold the bearing against a flood of blows with a deeply rooted aegis of qi.

name: Kingbearing Apex
description: Cut along the sovereign bearing with an edge that wounds the body and the qi that guards it.

name: Bearing Sovereign
description: The school's closing form: one stroke on the sovereign bearing that both cuts and holds with force rising with skill.
